resources.string: Fill forms, read messages and switch settings by voice: say "fill this form", "read this message" or "turn off Wi-Fi".

When you say "fill this form", ROOSTER fills the empty fields it recognises (name, phone, email, address, city, state, PIN code, date of birth) with the details you saved in ROOSTER. When you say "read this message", ROOSTER reads the messages on screen aloud, translated into your language if needed (the message text is sent to the ROOSTER assistant server only for that). When you ask ROOSTER to turn a setting such as Wi-Fi, mobile data or Bluetooth on or off, it opens that settings page, flips only that switch and goes back. It reads the screen only when you ask, never stores what is on screen, never presses submit, and never fills passwords, OTPs, PINs, card or bank details.
